title: Code-Guided Video Editing with Source-Grounded Executable Proxies
author: Yuanhong Zheng

categories.title: Camera editing
categories.description: Make the target composition visible before the final video is synthesized.

cases.title: A wider view of the clock tower
cases.edit: Reframe the clock tower as a wide shot.
cases.observation: Without a proxy, the framing stays close to the source. The guided result reveals more of the surrounding scene.

cases.title: More sea around the sailboat
cases.edit: Widen the view while retaining the sailboat.
cases.observation: The executable camera plan establishes the wider composition; the source remains the visual reference.

categories.title: Object addition
categories.description: Give new objects a concrete location, scale, and behavior in the existing shot.

cases.title: A wall clock, placed in context
cases.edit: Add a wall clock to the person's left.
cases.observation: The no-proxy clock is oversized. Proxy guidance follows the planned placement and scale more closely.

cases.title: A seagull above the coast
cases.edit: Add a flying seagull in the upper-left sky.
cases.observation: The guided bird stays closer to the proxy's intended location and scale, instead of dominating the foreground.

categories.title: Local modification
categories.description: Specify the intended change while giving the rest of the scene a persistent reference.

cases.title: Silver hair, same wardrobe
cases.edit: Age the woman while retaining her pose and position.
cases.observation: Both outputs perform the age edit. The guided result retains the white jacket, while the baseline changes the outfit.

cases.title: Metallic red, same scene
cases.edit: Change the green muscle car to metallic red.
cases.observation: Both versions perform the color edit. This example illustrates a localized change with the presenter and setting retained.

categories.title: Object removal
categories.description: Render the desired scene without the selected entity, then let the video model realize it.

cases.title: Remove the surrounding keyboard
cases.edit: Remove the crescent-shaped keyboard around the piano.
cases.observation: The keyboard ring remains in the no-proxy output and disappears with the edited scene proxy.

cases.title: A clear view through the window
cases.edit: Remove the person standing beside the window.
cases.observation: Both outputs remove the person. Compare the completed city view and the retained details of the room.

categories.title: Background replacement
categories.description: Plan a new environment while retaining the foreground subject.

cases.title: A new set, the same speaker
cases.edit: Replace the newsroom with a cyber command center.
cases.observation: The baseline creates an empty command room. The proxy-guided result keeps the speaker in the new environment.

cases.title: A tropical setting for the sports car
cases.edit: Place the sports car against a tropical beach.
cases.observation: Palm trees, surf, and seabirds establish the new background around the foreground car.

categories.title: Creative transformation
categories.description: Use procedural shapes and effects to give an imagined transformation a visible plan.

cases.title: From Ferris wheel to celestial portal
cases.edit: Transform the Ferris wheel into a glowing celestial portal.
cases.observation: The proxy organizes the portal and its reflection. The guided output forms a distinct blue-violet portal at the waterfront.

cases.title: Tea cups become tiny worlds
cases.edit: Transform the tea into miniature forest-and-pond ecosystems.
cases.observation: The guided transformation appears from the opening frames, while the no-proxy result introduces it gradually.

categories.title: Global stylization
categories.description: Give the requested visual treatment a concrete procedural preview.

cases.title: A portrait in graphic color
cases.edit: Render the portrait in a Pop Art aesthetic.
cases.observation: The baseline retains photographic texture. Proxy guidance brings in drawn contours, graphic color, and halftone detail.

cases.title: Rain over the lake
cases.edit: Give the lakeside scene a rainy atmosphere.
cases.observation: Clouds and rain establish the new weather, while the no-proxy result remains closer to the sunny source.

categories.title: Subtitle removal
categories.description: Express the underlying scene without text and retain its visual context.

cases.title: Clean sky, no subtitle band
cases.edit: Remove the subtitles from the aerial landscape.
cases.observation: The no-proxy output retains the top caption. The guided result removes the band while retaining the landscape.

cases.title: Clean frames for an animated scene
cases.edit: Remove the subtitles from the animated scene.
cases.observation: Subtitle text remains in the baseline; the proxy-guided output removes the overlay.
